# SonarQube Project Configuration # Sprint 6 – Statistical Code Review # # Usage (after generating a token at http://localhost:9000): # mvn clean compile sonar:sonar -Dsonar.token=<YOUR_TOKEN> # # Or with the standalone sonar-scanner CLI: # sonar-scanner -Dsonar.token=<YOUR_TOKEN>
sonar.projectKey=music-course-platform sonar.projectName=Music Course Platform sonar.projectVersion=1.0
# SonarQube server URL (default port) sonar.host.url=http://localhost:9000
# Source / test directories sonar.sources=src/main/java sonar.tests=src/test/java
# Compiled class output (required for Java analysis) sonar.java.binaries=target/classes sonar.java.test.binaries=target/test-classes
# Java source level (must match pom.xml) sonar.java.source=17
# File encoding sonar.sourceEncoding=UTF-8
# Exclude generated / build artefacts sonar.exclusions=target/**
